title: Geometry: Area, Angles, and Volume
preview: Area of composite figures, angle sums in triangles and quadrilaterals, and volume of right rectangular prisms with fractional edges.
description: Combined Module 8 & 9. Indiana standards 6.GM.2–4. Students decompose composite shapes to compute area, apply angle-sum theorems, and find volumes of prisms with fractional edge lengths.

sections.label: 8-1 Area of Composite Figures
sections.description: Compose or decompose polygons to compute area in real-world contexts.

sections.label: 8-2 Angles of Triangles (IN supplement)
sections.description: Apply the triangle angle-sum theorem to solve real-world and mathematical problems.

sections.label: 9-1 Volume of Rectangular Prisms
sections.description: Compute volume of right rectangular prisms with fractional edge lengths using V = lwh and V = Bh.
